references.text: Delilah asks Samson the same question for the first time about the secret behind his strength, showing the pattern of her manipulation.
After having tricked him once before, Delilah again asks Samson about his strength, demonstrating her persistent attempt to uncover his secret.
For the third time, Delilah tries to get Samson to reveal the source of his strength, confirming her claim that he has deceived her three times.
Samson's first wife used similar tactics with tears and accusations of lack of love to make him reveal the answer to the riddle.
Jacob was also tricked three times by Laban, illustrating a biblical pattern of repeated deception in close relationships.
